message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration features a portrait of a man from the chest up, wearing a black songkok hat and a black suit jacket over a white dress shirt and a dark, textured tie. He has light skin, gray hair, thin eyebrows, and mustache, and is wearing round, metal-rimmed spectacles. The man is smiling, showing his upper teeth. On the right side of his face, a black, ink-like splatter pattern covers part of his skin, spectacles, and hat. On his left lapel is a gold-colored pin. 

The background is light gray with a solid red bar on the left and a thinner red border at the bottom. Across the top, white text reads "LULUNG: SAYA MELUDAH JADI DUIT" and "KENAPA SISCA DIBUNUH." Below these, the word "TEMPO" is appears in large, red, serif letters. To the right of the man's head, black text says "SETELAH RUDI, SIAPA TERCIPRAT." Below this, smaller black text identifies the subject as "Rudi Rubiandini." Under the magazine title, smaller text reads "EDISI 19-25 AGUSTUS 2013." A barcode and price details are in the bottom left corner.
